# Protocol reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-reference.sh from crates/proto/proto. Do not edit by hand. -->

Grovedock speaks gRPC (HTTP/2, and gRPC-Web for browsers). The `gd.v1` package is stable: it changes only by adding. Generate a client for any language from the files below; the [SDKs](../agents.md#sdks) wrap the read calls for Python, TypeScript and Go.

Calls to a server that hosts many repositories name one with the `x-gd-repo: OWNER/NAME` header. Every call takes a bearer token in `authorization` when the server requires one.

### Refs

Refs name changesets: branches, and tags under `tags/` (`tags/v1.2.0`). A tag is made once (CompareAndSwap from nothing) and never moves: swapping an existing tag fails, and nothing lands on one. Git sees them as refs/tags/*.

| Call | Request | Response | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Get` | `RefName` | `RefValue` |  |
| `CompareAndSwap` | `CasRequest` | `CasResponse` |  |
| `List` | `Empty` | `RefList` |  |

### Land

Server-side rebase + lock-free compare-and-swap of a ref.

| `Rebase` | `ChangeRequestRef` | `ChangeRequest` | Re-applies the change on the target's tip. Edits that do not overlap what landed since are carried over; otherwise it fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION naming the files that conflict. Approvals made on the old version stop counting when the protection says so. Replays the branch's changes on the target's tip. Files both changed are merged line by line; it fails only where their edits clash (see Conflicts). |
| `Conflicts` | `ChangeRequestRef` | `ConflictReport` | Where a change request clashes with its target, file by file: the three versions, and the merge (clean, or with conflict markers where the edits clash). |
| `ResolveConflicts` | `ResolveConflictsRequest` | `ChangeRequest` | Rebases with the clashing files settled: each given in full, or deleted. Files that merge cleanly needn't be given. |
| `RevertAgent` | `RevertAgentRequest` | `RevertPlan` | Undoes everything an agent landed on a branch since a time, as one change request (or, with dry_run, says what that would undo). Later changes by others to the same files are kept where they don't overlap; where they do, the file is left as it is and listed. |

## `gd_runs.proto`

[Source](https://github.com/grovedock/gd/blob/main/crates/proto/proto/gd_runs.proto)

### Runs

| Call | Request | Response | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ListRuns` | `ListRunsRequest` | `ListRunsResponse` | Runs of a repository, newest first. Read access. |
| `GetRun` | `RunRef` | `Run` |  |
| `ReadLog` | `ReadLogRequest` | `ReadLogResponse` | A job's log, from a byte offset: call again with `next_offset` to follow a live job. |
| `CancelRun` | `RunRef` | `Run` | Write access. |
| `RerunRun` | `RerunRequest` | `Run` | Runs it again on the same change: the failed jobs (and what needs them), or all. |
| `ListWorkflows` | `ListWorkflowsRequest` | `ListWorkflowsResponse` | The workflows a branch has (default: the default branch): what starts each, its jobs, and why one can't be read. Read access. |
| `ArtifactUrl` | `RunArtifactRef` | `ArtifactLink` | A link to download one of a run's artifacts (files a job kept), good for a few minutes. |
| `StartRun` | `StartRunRequest` | `Run` | Starts a workflow that can be started by hand (`manual`, GitHub's `workflow_dispatch`). |
| `ApproveRun` | `RunRef` | `Run` | Lets a run of an outsider's code (a fork) go ahead. Maintain access. |
| `SetSecret` | `SetSecretRequest` | `Empty` | Secrets: names and when they changed are listed; values are never sent back. Only runs of code already on a protected branch get them. Admin access. |
| `ListSecrets` | `RepositoryRef` | `ListSecretsResponse` |  |
| `DeleteSecret` | `SecretRef` | `Empty` |  |
| `RegisterRunner` | `RegisterRunnerRequest` | `RegisterRunnerResponse` | Runners belong to an owner (a person or an organisation) and take jobs for its repositories. Registering and removing need the owner's administrators. |
| `ListRunners` | `ListRunnersRequest` | `ListRunnersResponse` |  |
| `RemoveRunner` | `RemoveRunnerRequest` | `Empty` |  |
| `ClaimJob` | `ClaimJobRequest` | `ClaimJobResponse` | Called by runners, which identify themselves with their key in the `x-gd-runner` header (not a person's token). Waits up to `wait_ms` for a job that fits the runner's labels. |
| `RunnerArtifacts` | `RunnerArtifactsRequest` | `RunnerArtifactsResponse` | Links for a job's runner to upload an artifact of its run, or download one (empty `name`: every artifact of the run). |
| `RunnerRelease` | `RunnerReleaseRequest` | `RunnerReleaseResponse` | Makes (or adds to) a release from a trusted run, as whoever caused the run, and gives links to upload its files. The job's steps never hold a token that could do this. |
| `ReportJob` | `ReportJobRequest` | `ReportJobResponse` | Progress of a claimed job: log output, steps, and finally its result. Answers whether the job was cancelled, so the runner stops it. |
